AiReplacement.description: Settings for the optional Umbraco.Community.Sanitiser.AI replacer.

ProfileAlias.description: Alias of the Umbraco.AI chat profile to use. Leave empty to use the default chat profile.

BatchSize.description: Number of fictional people to request per AI call. Larger batches make fewer, cheaper calls. Minimum 1.

TimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum seconds to wait for a single AI generation before falling back to templated values, so a slow or hung model cannot block startup. Minimum 1.
